verdict.rationale: Pylon is a SaaS platform with extensive AI features, so a no-training or opt-out data policy is a fair axis. However, the evidence pack has no statement that customer data is excluded from model training, nor any opt-out control. The 'training data' docs describe connecting knowledge sources for Pylon's AI to consume, not training-use protections. The SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications are adjacent security posture and do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
